Drawer inside size

Measure between the inner walls of the drawer. Make the dividers about 10 mm lower than the inside height so they clear the counter when the drawer opens and closes.

      Preview

      Take a photo of the open drawer and the dividers are placed in it at their real size.

      Drag to turn the view. On a phone, swipe sideways to turn and use the slider for height.

      1. Open the drawer and shoot at an angle from above the front, with all four inside bottom corners in the frame.
      2. Drag the four dots onto the inside bottom corners: back left, back right, front right, front left.
      3. The dividers are drawn onto the photo at their designed size, in perspective.

      The photo is processed only in your browser and is never uploaded.

      View in AR on your phone

      Download a true-scale 3D model and use your phone's camera to place it in the real drawer.

      How to use AR on a phone

      Android: open this page in Chrome and tap “View in the drawer (AR)”; the first time, it asks for camera access. Open the drawer and move the phone slowly over its floor. When a ring appears, tap the screen to place the dividers, then drag with one finger and turn with two until the green outline lines up with the inner walls (the orange edge is the front). The phone needs ARCore support.

      iPhone / iPad: open this page in Safari and tap “View in the drawer (AR)” to open the built-in AR Quick Look. Point at the drawer floor; when the model appears, drag it and turn it with two fingers until the translucent base lines up with the drawer floor.

      Model files: “Download AR model” gives you a zip with drawer-dividers.usdz for iPhone and drawer-dividers.glb for 3D viewers on Android or a computer, both at true scale.

      iPhone / iPad: in the Files app, tap the downloaded zip to unzip it, open drawer-dividers.usdz and switch to “AR” at the top. Point at the drawer floor; when the model appears, drag it and turn it with two fingers until the translucent base lines up with the drawer floor. Keep it at 100% and what you see is true size.

      Android: unzip it and open drawer-dividers.glb in a 3D or AR viewer that supports GLB. The built-in apps differ from phone to phone; some phones need one installed.

      About this tool

      Measure the inside of your drawer, drag horizontal and vertical dividers onto the top view, and get a cut list you can take straight to the saw. It works for cutlery drawers, utensil trays, tool drawers and desk organizers, with no sign-up and nothing to install.

      • Lay out dividers freelyDrag, stretch and evenly space dividers in groups. Even spacing can start from a neighboring divider, which makes small compartments easy.
      • Cut list and hole positionsWall clearance is taken off automatically. Cross half-laps, dados and T butt joints are detected, and the center of every slot and nail hole is listed.
      • Stock layoutShows how to cut each length of stock, allowing for the saw kerf, with the yield and the offcuts.
      • 3D and photo previewTurn a 3D model, or overlay the dividers in perspective on a photo of your drawer.
      • AR on your phonePlace true-scale dividers in the open drawer with the camera, in Chrome on Android or Safari on iPhone.

      Your designs and photos stay in your own browser and are never uploaded.
